test_cases.name: hotfix_does_not_come_here
test_cases.input: /plan khôi phục checkout đang trả 500 trên production
assertions: Says a hotfix does not come to /plan and names /debug → /verify → /ship
Does NOT invoke writing-plans

test_cases.name: no_spec_suggests_spec
assertions: Stops and suggests /spec
Does NOT write a plan file

test_cases.name: approval_asked_once
assertions: Asks once: Has this spec been reviewed and approved?
Stops when it is not approved
Skips the question when the user already approved it in this session

test_cases.name: blocks_on_unaccepted_adr
test_cases.input: /plan spec có ## Decisions trỏ tới ADR 0004 Status: proposed
assertions: Reads the spec's ## Decisions section
Stops and suggests /adr <spec path> because ADR 0004 is not accepted
Does NOT start planning while any linked ADR is not accepted

test_cases.name: blocks_architecture_change_without_decisions
test_cases.input: /plan spec ghi thay đổi schema nhưng không có ## Decisions
assertions: Stops and suggests /adr because an architecture change has no recorded outcome

test_cases.name: adr_skipped_line_counts_as_decision
test_cases.input: /plan spec có ## Decisions chứa `ADR skipped by user`
assertions: Continues to planning
Says in one line that the ADR was waived

test_cases.name: invokes_writing_plans_and_saves_with_stem
assertions: Invokes superpowers:writing-plans with the spec as input and holds its Execution Handoff
Saves .physarum/docs/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md reusing the spec's date+topic stem

test_cases.name: ui_spec_design_copied_into_plan
assertions: Copies the spec's Copy, Thesis (when the spec has one) and Acceptance checks into the plan's Global Constraints
Gives every UI task a `Design:` line naming the spec section

test_cases.name: stops_after_method_chosen
assertions: Asks the user to review the plan and choose subagent-driven or inline
Stops once the plan is reviewed and the method is chosen, suggesting /implement <plan path> <method>
Does NOT invoke subagent-driven-development or executing-plans
